get.description: Returns a paginated list of form instances the caller has access to. Supports filtering and sorting via query parameters.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Fetch only forms with this status.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Define which page to fetch, using the limit property to define how many items a page will contain. (0 indexed)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Define how many items to include per page.

parameters.name: formTemplateId
parameters.description: Specify a form template ID to filter by.

parameters.name: finalizedAtFrom
parameters.description: Fetch forms with a finalizedAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: finalizedAtUntil
parameters.description: Fetch forms with a finalizedAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

parameters.name: sortField
parameters.description: Specify the field used for sorting.

parameters.name: sortDirection
parameters.description: Define the sort order of the received payload.

get.description: Returns the details of a single form instance identified by its ID.

counter.description: Form instance counter. In the UI, this is shown as "FM-001-000001", but here, it is returned as a regular number.

relatedWorkOrderId.description: The internal ID of the related work order.

updatedAt.description: When this form was last updated

data.description: A list of forms along with their summary.

counter.description: Form instance counter. In the UI, this is shown as "FM-001-000001", but here, it is returned as a regular number.

relatedWorkOrderId.description: The internal ID of the related work order.

updatedAt.description: When this form was last updated

data.description:
Contains the form data in key value pairs.
The key is always the form field ID and should always be defined.
The value format depends on the type of the field.
If the value is empty, it will be returned as "null".
